prompt_md: With the plug in, the tap fills a bathtub in 6 minutes. A full tub drains in 9 minutes. With the tap on and the plug out, how many minutes to fill the empty tub?
prompt_short: Tap fills a tub in 6 min, drain empties it in 9. Both on: minutes to fill?
hint_md: What fraction of the tub fills in one minute?
explain_intuition_md: Subtracting the times makes no sense: the tub fills, just slowly. Each minute the tap adds a sixth and the drain takes a ninth, leaving an eighteenth.
